message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: Person used a lighter to set fire in a dormitory, causing property damage valued 4040 yuan. This is arson. In Chinese criminal law, "放火" (arson) is the crime. The list includes "放火" and also "失火". Need to differentiate: "放火" is intentional arson; "失火" is accidental fire (negligent). Here the person intentionally set fire due to hallucination from drug use. So it's intentional. So "放火". Also maybe "吸毒" but not a crime listed. The list includes "容留他人吸毒" etc. Not relevant. So single crime: 放火.

Thus answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>
